description: Shared clause battery for the mirrored heuristic risk rules. The TypeScript offline fallback (apps/api/src/services/ml.ts, fallbackClassify) and the Python service rules (apps/ml-service/risk_rules.py, compute_local_heuristics) must agree on every entry, tier for tier and confidence for confidence. Both test suites load this file: apps/api/tests/ml-boundary.test.mjs and apps/ml-service/tests/test_risk_rules.py. Uncalibrated review rules, not legal advice or trained-model probabilities.
